integrity: The mathematical theorem is supported by a complete combinatorial proof and reproducible independent finite checks; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: The underlying simplicial complex is the one-dimensional multipartite graph, not its clique complex.
No extension is proved for arbitrary subgraphs, pure strong-matching subcomplexes or all acyclic Morse matchings.
Ten finite instances are checked computationally; the unbounded theorem is proved by localization and elementary collapses.
Literature comparisons do not exclude unindexed work; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Two-part localization of strong graph-Morse complexes for all complete multipartite graphs
